### Are You Free from Guilt?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-july-1-2023.html
Passage: Zechariah 3:3
Points:
- In the vision, Joshua the high priest stood before the Angel wearing filthy clothes, representing all of God's people.
- Satan had an ironclad case against Joshua because Joshua was undeniably guilty and had no self-defense.
- Joshua's soiled garments illustrate the spiritual condition of all people who lack the righteousness of Jesus Christ.
- True freedom and healing can only begin when a sinner stops making excuses and honestly admits their guilt before God.

### This One Is Mine
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/harvest-daily-september-7-2005-1351222.html
Passage: Zechariah 3:2
Points:
- The devil regularly follows up temptation with condemnation in an effort to drive believers away from God.
- In Zechariah's vision, Joshua stood condemned before the Angel of the Lord with Satan actively accusing him.
- The Lord abruptly halted the enemy's attack by rebuking Satan and claiming Joshua as a brand plucked from the fire.
- Believers can find comfort knowing they belong to the Lord, who silences the accuser's attempts to defeat them.
